blue sky. Along the bottom third of the frame, four very different
pirates haul treasure across the deck by the rail: on the left a burly
bald man in his forties with a thick black beard and a sleeveless brown
leather jerkin, bent under a heavy wooden chest; next to him a skinny
red-haired young man of twenty, freckled and clean-shaven, in a striped
shirt and a blue headscarf, dragging a sack; then a grey-haired old
sailor with a white stubble and a wide-brimmed straw hat, carrying a
small iron-bound casket; on the right a tall dark-skinned man in his
thirties with braided hair, a red sash and an open white shirt, lifting
a chest onto his shoulder. White sails at the left and right edges. The
upper two thirds of the frame are open plain sky. Bright sunlight.
